description: This Java class 'JsonObjectValueValidator' is a final, immutable validator for parsing and validating JSON object strings within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract validator to check if a given CharSequence correctly represents a JSON object, throwing a specific exception if validation fails.

classes.name: JsonObjectValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed into a JSON object, raising an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JsonObjectValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to validate the input CharSequence by attempting to parse it as a JSON object.
